market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. US jobs data shock and ECB rate hike create near-term volatility. Oil gains and copper highs keep traders cautious (S&P slipped). Inflation data and Oracle earnings this week are key catalysts. Crypto holds firm on rate watch. Expect range-bound equity action with sector rotation from mega-cap AI into adjacent infrastructure and EM.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but uneven. AI capex supercycle (TSMC, Nvidia, IREN) supports multi-year earnings growth, but South Korea's 'wall of reality' and valuation vulnerability cap upside. EM and frontier markets (India, Africa, Poland) offer structural growth. Retail/consumer faces secular decline. Energy transition + AI power demand creates durable infrastructure theme. Crypto institutionalization is a multi-year trend.
